localised_description: One of the court's parties wants one of its men seated in a vacant office. Its party card names the man and the office. Seat him before the time runs out and its loyalty rises; let it run out, or give the office to someone else, and it falls.
localised_mission_completed_text: The office is filled as it asked, and the party is satisfied.

localised_description: One of the court's parties wants one of its men made governor of a province. Its party card names the man and the province. Appoint him before the time runs out and its loyalty rises; let it run out, or give the province to someone else, and it falls.
localised_mission_completed_text: The province has the governor it asked for, and the party is satisfied.
